assumptions.statement: At one fixed r_* and one fixed structural X with X_A=chi_A(X), all displayed fine and parent factor spaces are nonempty standard-Borel spaces; X and X_A stay outside the random channel, and no cross-X factorization through X_A is asserted.

P_I(do,dY|X) is a fixed normalized generative joint with a selected measurable observation-indexed regular-conditional kernel o->Pi_{I,o,X}; the generative law is fixed before recognition and no generative kernel reads recognition or posterior data.
At the admitted (o,X), Q_{I,o,X} is a normalized correlated recognition law absolutely continuous with respect to the selected Pi_{I,o,X}.
A sigma-finite observation reference and one density representative p_X are declared, 0<p_X(o)<infinity at the admitted regular observation, and the identical representative is reused at both scales.

C_A:Y_I~>Z_A is one normalized measurable Markov kernel, fixed independently of recognition, posterior, recognition parameters, and realized observation, acting only on fine random variables and leaving the observation coordinate unchanged.
At fixed X_A, (m_A,xi_A,E)->K^{X_A}_{A,m_A}(xi_A;E) is a jointly measurable normalized kernel family on B_A x O x H_A.
When ev_A is predeclared rather than induced from the pushed parent disintegration, its kernel agrees almost surely with the selected conditional of (B_A,O,H_A) given (M_A,Xi_A) under P_A.

For the holonomy-blind branch, a typed groupoid supplies source/target actions, covariant fine generation, jointly compatible selected posterior versions, covariant recognition, C_A equivariance, and covariant model evaluation; same-slice invariance additionally restricts to the stabilizer of fixed o and X.

For the retention branch, H_A explicitly contains measurable component roots, raw root-framed based-holonomy data, and dressed boundary marks, and C_A outputs these records jointly with the other parent coordinates.
A concrete parent declares one holonomy semantic branch and supplies all hypotheses of that branch: full-law covariance/equivariance for blindness, or explicit raw-record output for retention.

Any dynamic statement separately declares differentiable fine and parent state spaces and fields with a moving deterministic map c_t, or fine and parent Markov semigroups with the stated operator domains.

evidence.scope: Direct proof of the fixed-X standard-Borel parent construction, observation-indexed posterior pushforward, common-channel absolute continuity, induced-versus-predeclared evaluation seam, derived marginals, extended KL chain, finite VFE and recovery equivalences, full-law holonomy alternatives, and the typed dynamic boundary.
side_conditions: The theorem is pointwise in one fixed X and does not infer cross-X sufficiency from X_A=chi_A(X).
A predeclared evaluation family requires explicit almost-sure compatibility; only the induced tier obtains compatibility by construction.
Ordinary VFE differences and common-recovery equivalence require finite fine KL; the extended identity is additive and never subtracts infinities.
Holonomy covariance requires all joint action, version, channel, law, and evaluation hypotheses; same-slice invariance requires the fixed-(o,X) stabilizer.
The dynamic equations are typed conditional statements and do not establish autonomy or nonequilibrium behavior.

claims.statement: Mixed target. Conditional-universal affirmative conjunct: for every declared standard-Borel fine and parent datum satisfying the frozen premises, construct the full normalized pointwise parent probabilistic datum by one normalized recognition-independent channel, derive its parent posterior and recognition laws and their projections, prove the exact VFE chain identity with its nonnegative conditional-KL defect and equality criterion, and establish exactly one declared full-law holonomy alternative. Negative conjuncts: Task 4 must give direct in-domain counterexamples to marginal determination of a full parent law, unconditional split-channel VFE identities, model-marginal sufficiency for evaluation compatibility, trivial-holonomy sufficiency for agreement, and marginal invariance sufficiency for joint-law invariance.
claims.quantifiers: Affirmative: for every finite nonempty active set I at one fixed r_*, every declared standard-Borel fine random space Y_I and parent factors B_A, M_A, Xi_A, H_A, every fixed structural datum X with X_A=chi_A(X), every admitted regular observation o with finite unchanged evidence, every normalized fixed generative law P_I(do,dY|X), every selected posterior Pi_{I,o,X} derived from that law, every normalized correlated recognition law Q_{I,o,X} absolutely continuous with respect to Pi_{I,o,X}, every normalized measurable recognition-independent Markov kernel C_A:Y_I~>Z_A=B_A x M_A x Xi_A x H_A, every normalized measurable parent evaluation ev_A:M_A->Kern(Xi_A,B_A x O_A x H_A), and every almost-sure evaluation-compatible parent conditional, the stated parent-law, posterior, projection, VFE, and declared holonomy-alternative conclusions hold. Negative: there exist declared finite categorical data within the frozen types witnessing each listed overreach failure.
claims.falsifier: Each direct finite categorical witness establishes its existential negative conjunct by refuting the corresponding listed universal overreach. An affirmative conjunct is falsified only by an in-domain datum satisfying every frozen premise but violating a stated affirmative conclusion; inability to derive it remains unresolved.

claims.statement: At fixed r_*, X, and X_A=chi_A(X), the declared nonempty standard-Borel factor spaces form the standard-Borel parent product Z_A, structural data remain outside the random channel, and displayed fine belief/model laws are marginals of the correlated Q_{I,o,X} rather than presumed joint lifts.
claims.quantifiers: For every datum satisfying ASM-POINTWISE-STANDARD-BOREL, ASM-FINE-GENERATIVE-POSTERIOR, and ASM-RECOGNITION-AC.
claims.falsifier: An in-scope factor product that is not standard Borel, a randomized structural X inside C_A, or a displayed fine marginal not obtained from the declared correlated law.

claims.statement: The parent evaluator is concretely a jointly measurable normalized kernel family (m_A,xi_A,E)->K^{X_A}_{A,m_A}(xi_A;E), with no inferred measurable structure on an abstract kernel space and no automatic presentation quotient.
claims.quantifiers: For every family satisfying ASM-MODEL-EVALUATION-FAMILY at fixed X_A.
claims.falsifier: A claimed family member that is not normalized, or a measurable parent event for which evaluation is not measurable in (m_A,xi_A).

claims.statement: Pushing the fixed fine generative joint through the one observation-preserving C_A constructs a normalized measurable parent generative joint P_A with unchanged observation marginal.
claims.quantifiers: For every fine joint and channel satisfying ASM-POINTWISE-STANDARD-BOREL, ASM-FINE-GENERATIVE-POSTERIOR, and ASM-COMMON-CHANNEL.
claims.falsifier: An in-scope normalized fine law and normalized channel whose pushed parent has mass other than one or changes the observation marginal.

claims.statement: The measurable kernel o->Pi_{I,o,X}C_A is a selected regular-conditional version of the parent latent state given observation under P_A, proved globally by bounded test functions before specialization to admitted o.
claims.quantifiers: For every selected fine observation-indexed posterior kernel and common channel satisfying ASM-FINE-GENERATIVE-POSTERIOR and ASM-COMMON-CHANNEL.
claims.falsifier: A bounded-test-function violation of the parent disintegration identity or a nonmeasurable pushed observation-indexed kernel.

claims.statement: The same C_A pushes Q_{I,o,X}<<Pi_{I,o,X} to Q_{A,o,X}<<Pi_{A,o,X}.
claims.quantifiers: For every admitted pair and channel satisfying ASM-RECOGNITION-AC and ASM-COMMON-CHANNEL.
claims.falsifier: A parent event null under Pi_{A,o,X} but positive under Q_{A,o,X}.

claims.statement: A selected disintegration of pushed P_A induces an almost-sure evaluation family, while a predeclared family is compatible only under the explicit a.s. seam; under either tier the parent generative conditional equals K^{X_A}_{A,m_A} for the P_A (M_A,Xi_A) marginal almost surely.
claims.quantifiers: For every pushed parent law, either using its induced evaluator or additionally satisfying ASM-PREDECLARED-EVALUATION-COMPATIBILITY.
claims.falsifier: A positive-parent-mass (m_A,xi_A) set on which the selected parent conditional differs from the claimed evaluator despite the stated compatibility tier.

claims.statement: Parent recognition, latent-prior, and posterior belief/model marginals are exactly coordinate pushforwards of Q_{A,o,X}, P_A^Z(.|X), and Pi_{A,o,X}; none reconstructs its full law or evaluation conditional.
claims.quantifiers: For every parent datum established by PARENT-NORMALIZATION and POSTERIOR-PUSHFORWARD.
claims.falsifier: A bounded coordinate test function violating one of the stated projection identities.

claims.statement: The two joint lifts through the same C_A obey the additive [0,+infinity]-valued KL disintegration: fine KL equals parent KL plus the nonnegative conditional-KL defect, and the unchanged finite evidence representative yields the corresponding extended VFE identity without infinity-minus-infinity.
claims.quantifiers: For every pair satisfying ASM-RECOGNITION-AC, ASM-COMMON-CHANNEL, and ASM-EVIDENCE-REPRESENTATIVE.
claims.falsifier: An in-scope common channel for which joint-lift relative-entropy disintegration fails as an additive extended-nonnegative identity.

claims.statement: When fine KL is finite, the ordinary VFE difference equals Delta_A; Delta_A=0 exactly when discarded conditional recognition and posterior laws agree Q_A-a.s., equivalently when one normalized pairwise recovery kernel recovers both fine laws.
claims.quantifiers: For every in-scope common-channel pair with finite KL(Q_{I,o,X}||Pi_{I,o,X}).
claims.falsifier: A finite-KL pair with zero defect but unequal discarded conditionals, or common recovery without finite KL equality and zero defect under the stated hypotheses.

claims.statement: Under typed source/target groupoid actions, full fine-law covariance, compatible selected posterior versions, recognition covariance, C_A equivariance, and evaluation covariance, full parent generative, posterior, and recognition laws are covariant; same-slice invariance follows only on the fixed-(o,X) stabilizer.
claims.quantifiers: For every groupoid arrow and datum satisfying ASM-HOLONOMY-BLIND-DATA.
claims.falsifier: An arrow satisfying every stated covariance/equivariance identity whose pushed full parent law violates the corresponding covariance identity.

claims.statement: When H_A and C_A explicitly retain roots, raw root-framed holonomy, and boundary marks, full parent pushforwards retain their joint laws and correlations, with no quotient, averaged-link, or holonomy-blind claim.
claims.quantifiers: For every parent channel satisfying ASM-HOLONOMY-RETENTION-DATA.
claims.falsifier: A retained record measurable in H_A whose joint parent distribution is not its pushforward through C_A.

claims.statement: A concrete parent may declare either the fully hypothesis-backed holonomy-blind covariance branch or the raw-retention branch; marginal stabilization alone establishes neither and neither selects membership.
claims.quantifiers: For every concrete parent that declares one branch with that branch's hypotheses.
claims.falsifier: A declared branch satisfying its full hypotheses but not its stated full-law conclusion.

claims.statement: For a separately declared differentiable moving-map special case the exact semiconjugacy defect is partial_t c_t + D c_t V_t - Vbar_t o c_t; for Markov evolution exact closure requires semigroup or generator intertwining on declared domains, and the static construction proves neither.
claims.quantifiers: For every separately declared special case satisfying ASM-DYNAMIC-SPECIAL-CASE.
claims.falsifier: A differentiable trajectory violating the moving-map chain rule, or claimed Markov closure lacking the stated intertwining/domain condition.

claims.statement: There exist finite parent laws with identical belief and model marginals but distinct dependence, refuting universal reconstruction of the full parent from those marginals.
claims.quantifiers: There exists the Task-4 finite categorical witness within the frozen types.
claims.falsifier: Failure of the Task-4 witness to have identical marginals and distinct joints.

claims.statement: There exist finite data for which different recognition and posterior/generative channels violate the unconditional common-channel contraction and VFE identity.
claims.quantifiers: There exists the Task-4 finite categorical split-channel witness within the frozen types.
claims.falsifier: Failure of the Task-4 split-channel witness to produce the stated coarse mismatch.

claims.statement: There exist normalized model marginals and a predeclared evaluation family that disagree with the pushed parent generative conditional, refuting model-marginal sufficiency for evaluation compatibility.
claims.quantifiers: There exists the Task-4 finite categorical evaluation-mismatch witness within the frozen types.
claims.falsifier: Failure of the Task-4 predeclared evaluator to disagree on positive parent mass.

claims.statement: There exist trivial-holonomy data with unequal transported laws, refuting trivial holonomy as sufficient for belief or model agreement.
claims.quantifiers: There exists the Task-4 finite tree witness within the frozen types.
claims.falsifier: Failure of the Task-4 trivial-holonomy witness to retain unequal laws.

claims.statement: There exist full parent laws with invariant coordinate marginals but noninvariant joint dependence, refuting marginal holonomy invariance as sufficient for full-law invariance.
claims.quantifiers: There exists the Task-4 finite correlated/anticorrelated witness within the frozen types.
claims.falsifier: Failure of the Task-4 witness to have invariant marginals and a changed joint under the declared action.
